headline: Skylight’s smart calendars are up to $90 off during its back-to-school sale
summary: Skylight smart calendars are on sale for back-to-school, offering up to $90 off. These shared smart calendars help families manage hectic schedules during the school year. The limited-time sale runs from August 2nd to August 9th.

headline: HP’s HyperX Omen 15 isn’t quite the budget-friendly gaming laptop its predecessor was
summary: The new HP HyperX Omen 15 replaces the former budget bestseller, the HP Victus 15. Despite nice upgrades like an RTX 5050, the Omen 15 is less affordable. It offers improvements but loses its predecessor's key budget appeal.

headline: Is paying artists enough to convince them to embrace AI?
summary: Artists have long expressed concern about generative AI models using their work without permission. This has led to contentious legal battles and accusations of theft. The debate continues on whether compensation can bridge the gap between AI development and artist rights.

headline: Foldables are sort of boring now — and that’s great news for Apple
summary: Foldable phones are becoming normalized and less novel, indicating a maturing market. This evolution of the foldable market could greatly benefit Apple. The article explores the implications of this trend for future smartphone innovations.

headline: What the Heck Is Marvel Doing With the Hulk Anyway!?
summary: The article questions Marvel's current creative direction for the Hulk character. It specifically asks about the hero's path following "Spider-Man: Brand New Day." Fans are left wondering about the future narrative of the iconic green giant.

headline: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Beats Avengers: Endgame Record to Claim Biggest Domestic Opening Day of All Time
summary: Marvel Studios' "Spider-Man: Brand New Day" achieved a record-breaking opening day at the domestic box office. It surpassed "Avengers: Endgame" to claim the biggest domestic opening day ever. The film earned an impressive $168 million in its first day.

headline: Game of Thrones: The Mad King Reveals Full Stage Cast and First Portrait
summary: The stage play "Game of Thrones: The Mad King" has unveiled its complete cast lineup. A first official portrait shows key characters like King Aerys II and Rhaegar Targaryen. Young Ned Stark is also confirmed to be part of the ensemble.

headline: Vincent Pastore, The Sopranos Actor, Dies at 80
summary: Actor Vincent Pastore, widely known for his role in "The Sopranos," has passed away at the age of 80. He famously portrayed Salvatore Bonpensiero in the groundbreaking TV series. Pastore's death marks the loss of a significant figure from the acclaimed show.

headline: Prolonged drought could cause shortage of some foods, farmers' union head says
summary: A prolonged drought is raising fears of potential food shortages in the UK. The NFU president, Tom Bradshaw, has urged the government to address the impact of extreme weather. Concerns are growing over the stability of the nation's food supply.

headline: Trump cancels Iran strikes subject to deal being made 'rapidly'
summary: President Trump canceled planned strikes against Iran, stating a deal could be made 'rapidly.' He claimed other Middle Eastern countries requested Washington to hold off on any attack. Trump indicated that the 'perimeters' of a potential deal had been agreed upon.

headline: Man admits killing British woman found in suitcase, Greek police say
summary: A man has confessed to killing 38-year-old Elisabeth-Jane Ross, whose body was found in a suitcase. Greek police confirmed the arrest, adding charges of robbery and weapons offenses. The incident highlights a tragic case involving a British national abroad.

headline: Five dead, 41 missing, after Indonesia ferry catches fire
summary: A ferry fire off Madura island, Indonesia, has resulted in five confirmed deaths. At least 41 people are still reported missing from the burning vessel. The ferry was carrying approximately 250 passengers and crew when the incident occurred.
